binary_repeatability: Observed binary hash authenticates this retained execution only; different build paths/compilers need source/build provenance, not a claim of identical native bytes.
cohort_role: Released-example method validation; paired-cohort settings must be frozen separately before new cohort execution

fixed_pose_rescorer.fullsearch_comparison: A common reference shifts all scores equally only for the same ligand/torsion normalization. Verify normalization before pooling; do not substitute per-pose score_only.
fixed_pose_rescorer.purpose: within-one-fixed-ligand common-pose-pool ranking; absolute scores must not be interpreted as calibrated cross-ligand affinities

native_build_support: Darwin arm64 with Apple clang and make

required_input_conventions.atom_serials: contiguous in record order, starting at 1
required_input_conventions.donor: C1 only; non-C1/sialic donors explicitly unsupported by this adapter
required_input_conventions.environment: VINA_CARB points to the extracted VC_1_0 directory
required_input_conventions.residue_ids: distinct sequential number for each source monosaccharide
required_input_conventions.ring: complete supported pyranose ring; upstream VC_log must confirm both phi and psi recognition

score_only_warning: The original --score_only code path omits CHI. It is not a carbohydrate-aware common-pose rescoring operation.
search_differences_from_vina_1_2_7: post-search distinct pose separation is hard-coded at 1 Angstrom
CHI cutoff explicitly set; default discrepancy between manual and original source is avoided by specifying it
seed_interpretation_audit: Checked against original main.cpp and observedlogseed0 before anybenchmarkcohortexecution.

source.kind: original authors versioned distribution; no Git commit claimed

tutorial.role: published CCBRC university tutorial workflow replay; not the original Vina-Carb paper benchmark
tutorial.seed_semantics: Explicit seed0 is fixed in thisoriginalversion; auto_seed iscalledonlywhen --seedisabsent (src/main/main.cpp lines592–593). Acrossbuilds exactcoordinates are not assumed.
